meta.description: Registry for null-boundary failure modes in Phase 2 of the Mono-Process Formal Law Program.

failure_modes.name: threshold_aliasing
failure_modes.description: Distinct mismatch states are incorrectly classified as identical under the evaluated epsilon_null threshold.

failure_modes.name: boundary_instability
failure_modes.description: Participation classification switches erratically near the epsilon_null boundary under small perturbations.

failure_modes.name: null_non_null_ambiguity
failure_modes.description: Formal rules fail to provide a unique classification for states exactly at or near the epsilon_null threshold.

failure_modes.name: dynamic_floor_drift
failure_modes.description: Epsilon_null floor varies inconsistently with residue or orientation, leading to loss of addressability.

failure_modes.name: zero_measure_participation
failure_modes.description: The participation_space results in a set with zero measure despite non-null mismatch conditions.

failure_modes.name: infinite_measure_domain
failure_modes.description: The addressable domain measure is non-finite, preventing stable participation density calculation.

failure_modes.name: non_normalizable_density
failure_modes.description: Participation density calculation fails due to zero or non-summable domain measures.

failure_modes.name: mechanism_floor_conflict
failure_modes.description: Conflicting epsilon_null definitions between mechanism classes result in inconsistent formal projections.
